title: [review] message.rs:363: Dead match arm for OPT_PAD1
description: The match arm `OPT_PAD1 => {}` at line 363 in SignedDaoEnvelope::from_bytes is unreachable. PAD1 bytes are already handled by the while loop at lines 334-340 which calls `continue`, so execution never enters the else block (line 358) for PAD1. Remove the dead arm.
